description: This file contains a PHP class `Manufacturer` within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Catalog` namespace, which implements an administrative controller for managing manufacturers in an OpenCart system. It includes methods for listing, viewing, adding, editing, and deleting manufacturer entities, along with handling related data such as stores, images, SEO URLs, and pagination.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: PHP controller class for managing manufacturer data in the catalog section of the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations and listing functionality.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that prepares data for the manufacturer listing page, including sorting, pagination, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a view with the list of manufacturers, primarily used for AJAX or partial updates.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns HTML view of the manufacturer list, sorted and paginated based on request parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a manufacturer, pre-filled with existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving manufacturer data from the form submission, including creation or update.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected manufacturer entries.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete feature for manufacturer names, returning JSON data for suggestions.
